available_non_qualifying_evidence.description: The heart and HI pilot fixtures exercise routing and quality checks, but they are neither a held-out set nor independently reviewed by three blind reviewers.

blockers: No independently reviewed 50-case held-out set is present.
No case has a recorded two-of-three blind-review decision.
Shape and text recognition rates cannot be calculated.
Route-validity assertions cannot be applied to missing held-out outputs.
